meta.source: HAND-WRITTEN PLACEHOLDER. Replace with the Gemma-generated bank (about 8 situations x 3 tones x 10 lines) before claiming Gemma in the write-up.

gentle: You are free right now and it is {temp}°C outside. A short walk would be lovely.
Nice moment to step out: {temp}°C and nothing on your calendar. Even 10 minutes helps.
funny: Debt is {minutes} minutes. The park has been asking about you.
Your calendar is empty and it is {temp}°C. The sun has a vacancy and you have a debt.
cheeky: {minutes} minutes owed. Put the phone down and go touch some grass.
You are free, it is {temp}°C, and the only thing stopping you is you.

gentle: A free gap opens at {gap_start}. That could be a good time to step outside.
Around {gap_start} you are free and the weather should be pleasant.
funny: Your {gap_start} gap is booked. The park is the only guest.
{gap_start}: you, the outdoors, and {minutes} minutes of debt. Do not stand it up.
cheeky: Free at {gap_start}. No excuses, only shoes.
At {gap_start} you have no meeting, no deadline and no alibi.

gentle: It is {temp}°C out. Staying in is sensible. Try again around {best_time}.
Too hot right now. A better window is around {best_time}.
funny: It is {temp} degrees. Staying in is the correct decision. Come back at {best_time}.
The sun is in a mood at {temp}°C. Negotiate with it at {best_time}.
cheeky: {temp}°C? Even the grass is hiding. Go at {best_time}, not now.
Skipping the heat is not an excuse, it is strategy. Be outside by {best_time}.

gentle: It is only {temp}°C. Wrap up warm, or wait until {best_time}.
Chilly out there at {temp}°C. A warmer window is around {best_time}.
funny: {temp}°C. Your jacket has been waiting for this moment. Or try {best_time}.
It is {temp} degrees. Grass is crunchy. Maybe {best_time}.
cheeky: {temp}°C is not a reason, it is a dress code. Layer up or go at {best_time}.
Cold? Wear the sweater. Debt is {minutes} minutes and it does not care.

gentle: Rain is likely at this hour. Try again around {best_time}.
It may be wet outside. A drier window is around {best_time}.
funny: Rain is likely. The park is closed for watering. Try {best_time}.
The sky is doing laundry. Check back around {best_time}.
cheeky: A little rain never hurt anyone. Still, {best_time} looks drier.
Umbrella or {best_time}. Your choice, but you still owe {minutes} minutes.

gentle: You owe {minutes} minutes outside. Even 10 minutes would shrink it.
The balance is {minutes} minutes. A short break outdoors would help.
funny: Debt is {minutes} minutes. The park has started sending reminders.
You owe the outdoors {minutes} minutes. Interest is accruing in vitamin D.
cheeky: {minutes} minutes in the red. Your future self wants a word.
{minutes} minutes owed. The couch is not going to pay it for you.
